evidence_quotes: HCl-based technologies can achieve this at 20 °C and ambient pressure. These principles were disclosed in the 1920s, but the inability to economically separate sugars from acids impeded its commercialization. Avantium Chemicals B.V. developed a modern version of this “Bergius” highly concentrated acid hydrolysis, in which the saccharides in HCl are transformed into furanics without any prior purification
